question: Can this round obtain a real Binance/Testnet maintenance-margin bracket snapshot through any reachable read-only path, as section B3 requires?
answer: NO. There is no Testnet bracket reader in the running product.

onlyBracketCallSites: apps/engine/src/adapters/exchange/ExternalTradeAdapter.ts:202 setLeverage() — signed GET /fapi/v1/leverageBracket, used only to cap leverage at submit time; it keeps one number (initialLeverage) in an in-memory cache and discards the bracket rows

apps/engine/src/services/productionReadOnlyPreflight.ts:5,20,25 — signed GET /fapi/v1/leverageBracket, but that collector is bound to environment PRODUCTION (allowedMethods ['GET'], liveApproval PENDING_LIMITS_EXIT_PLAN_AND_EXPLICIT_ORDER_AUTHORIZATION) and is not a Testnet path
evidence.apiExposureSearched: grep over apps/engine/src/api found no route returning bracket data

probeResults.GET /api/v3/diagnostics/binance-governan: returns routes/egress only; egress VERIFIED (routeIdentity proxy-a087cc91667b, expected 172.104.186.174 == lastVerifiedEgressIp)
probeResults.GET /api/v3/settings/governance: reports riskGovernance.portfolioRisk.marginTierVersion='' editable:false, maintenanceMarginRatePct=null, correlationVersion/scenarioVersion/scenarios/clusters editable:false — the running server itself declares these unreadable-by-page
probeResults.settings.default.json: contains no riskGovernance.portfolioRisk object at all, so there is no shipped dataset to validate against

whyNotWorkedAround.noDirectDatabaseWrite: section C authorizes a Settings CAS write only; writing the settings row in SQLite would bypass the governance matrix, saveIfVersion and settings_audit, which is the opposite of what this round is for
whyNotWorkedAround.noMatrixEdit: riskGovernance.portfolioRisk.marginTierVersion/correlationVersion/scenarioVersion/scenarios/clusters are editable:false on purpose: readOnlyReason says a bracket table is an operator-supplied dataset that must arrive with offline validation, so a version string alone must never mean proven. Flipping those flags to make activation pass is exactly the gate-loosening the plan forbids (and section 0 forbids inventing a Binance margin-tier authority).
whyNotWorkedAround.noPlaceholderVersion: Writing marginTierVersion without the bracket snapshot it is supposed to name would create a fake PROVEN fact; the ledger only checks non-empty string + finite rate, so such a value would silently unlock real money paths on a lie.

whatActivationActuallyNeeds.step1Collector: a Testnet, read-only, rate-aware bracket snapshot: for the current positions plus the routed candidate universe, fetch /fapi/v1/leverageBracket per underlying, keep symbol/notionalFloor/notionalCap/maintenanceMarginRatio/initialLeverage, canonicalise deterministically (sorted, fixed numeric formatting), and expose { canonicalSnapshot, sha256, maxApplicableMaintenanceRatePct } where the rate is the maximum over the brackets that the sizing range can reach, never a guess
whatActivationActuallyNeeds.step2DatasetChannel: one audited whole-profile submission that validates the dataset together with its version (scenarios array + scenarioVersion, clusters map + correlationVersion, bracket snapshot + marginTierVersion + rate) and refuses when the version does not hash to the submitted dataset; the numeric limits keep using the existing governance field checks
whatActivationActuallyNeeds.step3HostileTests: version without dataset refused; dataset with mismatched version refused; rate taken from the maximum applicable bracket, not the average; universe entry missing a bracket fails closed; a bracket that changes later invalidates the version instead of silently reusing it; nothing writable through PUT /settings that PATCH refuses
whatActivationActuallyNeeds.then: only after that lands and is deployed, section C's CAS and section E's mode flip can be executed as written, with the real READY profile
